The y-axis appears to range from approximately 37 to 40 (or slightly above 39), not to 41. The maximum visible tick appears to be around 40, with the line reaching approximately 39.9.

The description does not mention the non-monotonic behavior of the Linear SAE line — it dips around x=1500 before rising sharply to ~39.9 at x=2000. This is a notable visual feature (a local decline followed by a peak) that should be described.
